service.description: The color of each status (a Quasar color name: grey-7, primary, warning, positive, negative or info) by its meaning, the status color map of style-guide §5.2: StatusItem.statusColor when the item has one (an app seeds the map for its statuses that way), else a color from the words of the status id, then of its description: ended badly (Cancel, Reject, Void, Lost, Fail, Error, Declin, Denied, Abort, Refus) negative; done well (Complete, Paid, Shipped, Deliver, Won, Resolved, Closed, Finish, Done, Confirm, Consumed, Accepted, Success) positive; waiting (Hold, Pending, Overdue, Backorder, Wait, Paus, Suspend, Expir) warning; draft and proposed (Draft, Propos, Creat, Request, Planning, NotStarted, Unassign, Inactive, Produced, New) grey-7; informational (Sent, Received, Viewed, Scheduled, Invoiced, Submitted, Ready) info; in progress (Approv, Progress, Open, Active, Picking, Assigned, Placed, Process, Running, Sending, Consuming, Started) primary; anything else grey-7.

The stages of a status flow and the transitions from the current status, for the status-bar element.
stages: the statuses in order (stageStatusIds when given, else the StatusItem rows of the type in sequenceNum order, without those that wait or end badly, such as On Hold and Cancelled, which show only when current, and on a flow other than Default only its StatusFlowItem statuses when it has any), each with its label (the description), color and state: done (before the current one), current or todo. A current status that is not a stage shows after the last stage whose sequence is not past its own (On Hold after In Progress), the stages before it done; one that ended badly (negative, such as Cancelled) shows last with nothing done.
transitions: the StatusFlowTransition rows of the flow (statusFlowId, Default when not given) from the current status, in transitionSequence order, that the user may take: a transition with a userPermissionId needs that permission, and with allowedToStatusIds only those statuses (an empty list allows none). Each has toStatusId, label (the transition name, localized, else the status description), color, isNext and isDanger (its color is negative). next is the primary action: the transition to the nearest stage after the current one, or with a current status off the stages the transition to the earliest stage (Resume, Re-open); it is first in transitions, the ones that end badly last.
The statusTypeId is that of the current status when not given. current is null without a statusId.

The columns of a form-list board and the colors of a calendar (the view-board and view-calendar elements, style-guide §3.6, §3.7, §8.2): for a status field (status true, or a statusTypeId), every status of the type in sequenceNum order (the type given, else the types of the status values) with its label (the description) and color (get#StatusColors), then each other value; for another field each value with the description of the status or enumeration it is, else the value as its label. flow is the StatusFlowTransition rows of the flow (Default when not given) between the statuses, which tell the board where a card may go.
